correctness.rationale: Explicit independent-set decomposition of the product and quotient forbidden permutations gives the exact integer formula; every factor and fixed-loop convention checked. Exact integer arithmetic proves sign for 2..79, and Lucas recurrence plus n≥80 monotone rational lower bound proves the remaining infinite range.

value.rationale: First-moment sign is central to recent moment-based studies of product/quotient-dominant subsets. The dicyclic family is expressly outside prior easy asymptotic criteria. Determining its sharp mean-sign transition at group order 120, with a formula and a uniform tail proof, is a structural contribution rather than a routine finite census. Majority dominance remains open.
